stemMd:
What is the monthly rent, if rent is the same every month?

(1) The rent for twelve months totals 14,400 euros.

(2) Utilities cost 200 euros each month.

Which assessment of sufficiency is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient, but neither is sufficient alone.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Even together the statements are not sufficient.

explanationMd: The annual rent and equal-month condition determine 14,400 divided by 12 = 1,200 euros. Utilities are a separate expense and supply no rent figure.

distractorRationale.b: Assess each statement separately before combining them. The annual rent and equal-month condition determine 14,400 divided by 12 = 1,200 euros. Utilities are a separate expense and supply no rent figure.
